_note: Every gameplay number lives here. Nothing tunable should be a const in a .gd file any more. tools/sim.gd plays hundreds of days against this file and prints the curves, so a change here can be checked without playing.
_contract: THE BALANCE CONTRACT. tools/sim.gd measures these from SIMULATED play, and tests/run.gd asserts them. The previous version asserted hand-set state, which is how a grade model broken in four places passed 218 tests.
bare room, perfect teaching  -> ~0.62  a C
full room, never helped      -> ~0.63  a C
full room, perfect teaching  -> ~0.97  an A
Homework is a bonus on top, so a good term survives one bad lesson.

lesson._note: work_seconds is how much UNSTUCK time a student needs to finish. lesson_seconds is the clock you are racing. A stalled student's timer freezes, so an unreached student simply never finishes — that is the whole pressure.

homework._note: not_done_forgiveness: a student who misses homework is asked again the next night rather than being locked out forever.

alphabet_frieze.blurb: Round the top of the wall, where it belongs.

fish_tank.name: Fish Tank
fish_tank.blurb: Somewhere for a wandering mind to land.

art_easel.blurb: Inspiring to sit near, if you sit near it.

lab_bench.blurb: The strongest boost there is, but only close by.

term._note: A run is a term. On the last day the class sits an exam scored on everything you built up, and that is the score you are playing for.

upkeep._note: Furniture needs replacing. A per-item daily cost means coins never just pile up, and a huge room you cannot afford is a real decision.

teacher._note: The teacher's own numbers. speed and pick_radius used to be consts in actor.gd/interactable.gd -- they were missed when everything else moved here, because they read as physics rather than balance. They live here now so perks can raise them and tools/sim.tscn can model a levelled teacher.

student._note: Students improve just by being taught. A level nudges aptitude and diligence a little; ready_level is when they can be sent up. XP STOPS at ready_level+hold_grace: a child kept long past readiness has learned what you can teach them, which is a soft cost for holding them back rather than a punishment.

graduation._note: What sending a child up is worth. Scaled by readiness, so graduating someone the moment they qualify pays less than seeing them through.

coaching._note: Bought from a student's own file. Cost multiplies per purchase FOR THAT CHILD, so the decision is who to invest in rather than levelling everyone flat.

brisk_walk.name: Brisk Walk
brisk_walk.blurb: You get around the room faster.

long_reach.name: Long Reach
long_reach.blurb: Help from a little further away.

steady_hands.name: Steady Hands
steady_hands.blurb: Carry any amount of work at once.

calm_presence.name: Calm Presence
calm_presence.blurb: Students near you get stuck less often.

practised_marker.name: Practised Marker
practised_marker.blurb: Judge fewer sheets a night; the rest go at your usual standard.

perk_effects._note: Per RANK. brisk_walk adds to teacher.speed, long_reach to pick_radius, calm_presence multiplies the stall chance of students within its radius, practised_marker removes that many sheets from the nightly pile.
